changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0067. Progress assessments gain height, bilateral measurements, fitness scores, visceral fat, and a photo table so each dated record can keep several consented images. Index review: existing PK and IX_MemberProgressAssessments_Member_Date stay. New PK_MemberProgressPhotos, FK to the assessment and tenant, and IX_MemberProgressPhotos_Assessment loads the photos for one member history. Performance note: a trainer reads one assigned member's assessments and their photos inside the current tenant.

rollback.sql: IF OBJECT_ID(N'app.MemberProgressPhotos', N'U') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE app.MemberProgressPhotos;

IF COL_LENGTH(N'app.MemberProgressAssessments', N'CoreScore') IS NOT NULL ALTER TABLE app.MemberProgressAssessments DROP CONSTRAINT CK_MemberProgressAssessments_Core, CK_MemberProgressAssessments_Flexibility, CK_MemberProgressAssessments_Endurance, CK_MemberProgressAssessments_Strength, CK_MemberProgressAssessments_Visceral, CK_MemberProgressAssessments_RightThigh, CK_MemberProgressAssessments_RightArm, CK_MemberProgressAssessments_Height;

IF COL_LENGTH(N'app.MemberProgressAssessments', N'Height') IS NOT NULL ALTER TABLE app.MemberProgressAssessments DROP COLUMN Height, RightArm, RightThigh, VisceralFat, StrengthScore, EnduranceScore, FlexibilityScore, CoreScore;
